description: Add or remove VAT for 30 European countries using their standard and reduced rates (or your own rate): net, VAT and gross amounts. Rates are built in, no outside call. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/eu-vat-calculator.
